snippet.title: Royal Dental Trailer
snippet.description:
Rise from peasant dentist to royal healer in this quirky medieval dental simulation RPG.

Royal Dental will be releasing to Steam and itch on March 4th, 2026!

Royal Dental on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4224920/Royal_Dental/
Royal Dental on itch: https://meerkatapult-games.itch.io/royal-dental
